name: Automated Execution Rigidity
definition: Execution cannot accommodate circumstances the code did not anticipate, and cannot be amended in time to matter.
trigger_conditions: Amendment requires a process slower than the harm
No circuit breaker or pause authority exists

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: rules are adaptable only where the process producing them integrates dynamic elements

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F026 Automated Execution Rigidity. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F026
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
